thread:
maya-marketing: Quick sync — planning a cross-region webinar with CloudPartner + marketplace listing live same week. Need a runbook: webinar, blog co-auth, benchmark asset, and inbound lead routing. Who can own what? :wave:

sam-integration: I can own the integration demo + environment. ETA for a stable demo: next Wed. Need a test tenant from CloudPartner.

alex-growth: I'll take benchmark narrative and landing page copy. Want to surface 3 headline metrics (latency, cost/1000 tokens, concurrency). Can we get sample traffic profile?

jordan-pm: I'll run the run-of-show and speaker roster. Suggest 45-60m webinar + 15m optional workshop. Who are we inviting from engineering?

lee-partner-ops: For inbound routing: we'll tag leads with partner=cloudpartner + source=marketplace_webinar. SFDC mapping ready. Do we have UTM params and partner lead acceptance SLA?

maya-marketing: @lee-partner-ops SLA = 24h business hours for MQL handoff. UTM syntax: utm_source=cloudpartner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cloudpartner_launch_v1. Can you confirm SFDC fields align?

lee-partner-ops: Confirmed. Also add field "co_marketing_partner" boolean. Will create lead queue: CloudPartner_Webinar_Q.

sam-integration: On the demo side — need to pin model + dataset snapshot for reproducible numbers. Suggest we put a tiny CLI snippet in the repo for attendees to run. Example: ```bash
redwoodctl demo --model rwd-1.0 --preset cloud-integ --seed 42
```

alex-growth: Love that. For the benchmark doc I'll add a comparison table and a short methodology section. Can someone supply tokenized transcript sample and avg seq len?

jordan-pm: @sam-integration can you own the demo checklist (slides + playback + dry-run) and schedule 2 rehearsals (internal + with CloudPartner) the week before?

sam-integration: Yep. I'll schedule dry-run 2 days before and partner dress rehearsal 1 day before.

ops-bot: Reminder: marketing-prod calendar event created: "CloudPartner Launch — Webinar + Marketplace" 2026-06-12T16:00:00Z. Invite includes Maya, Sam, Alex, Jordan, Lee, CloudPartner PMs.

maya-marketing: Great. Action items from this thread: 1) Sam — demo + rehearsals, 2) Alex — benchmark + landing copy, 3) Jordan — run-of-show + speakers, 4) Lee — SFDC routing + UTMs. I'll draft co-auth blog outline and share by EOD tomorrow. :spiral_note_pad:

lee-partner-ops: One more ask — can marketing provide a short pre-built nurture email for partner ops to send? 3 lines + CTA is perfect.

maya-marketing: On it. I'll drop a 3-line draft in #marketing-assets by EOD.

alex-growth: Also propose a short 1-min video clip for socials showing the integration flow — good for marketplace listing. Any objections?

jordan-pm: No objections. Add to the runbook under promo assets.

maya-marketing: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a checklist doc and PR links in this thread. :rocket:
